edits.new:
cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run docs:check
      - run: npm run docs:build

  v3-contract-closure-checks:
    name: v3-contract-closure-checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: 26
      - name: Preserve exact source, existing checks and dependency pins
        run: node scripts/check-v3-source-boundary.mjs
      - name: Fixed ControlPanel source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          repository: Kome-Lab/Autostream-ControlPanel
          ref: 3d6885c1ec3835b09cbeed1e83110d1111e237a3
          path: .ws7-sources/cp
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Fixed Updater source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          repository: Kome-Lab/Autostream-Updater
          ref: 5741d48d94f6fe7c6727f637ea32667860882dfd
          path: .ws7-sources/updater
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Fixed Observability source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          repository: Kome-Lab/Autostream-Observability
          ref: 14da2031a46c755c9201f94ac57a7a2a99f8d0b9
          path: .ws7-sources/observability
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Fixed Docker checker source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          repository: Kome-Lab/Autostream-Docker
          ref: 8ca3f9102752d67bca2049f5039ad874112012ac
          path: .ws7-sources/docker
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Frozen Contracts source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          repository: Kome-Lab/Autostream-Contracts
          ref: d32ea3514b1c1010391caae0348b0ff9e751f447
          path: .ws7-sources/contracts
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Frozen Media fixture source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          repository: Kome-Lab/Autostream-Encoder-Recorder
          ref: 7c7ec14d2b06b866ebd5b006331f55ba01da8dfe
          path: .ws7-sources/encoder
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Source existence, content and exact consumer-vector references
        run: node scripts/check-v3-fixed-sources.mjs "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.ws7-sources"
      - name: Required Feature Scenario Runbook roots without skips
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/check-v3-contract-closure.mjs
          node --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/test-v3-contract-closure.mjs | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/ws7-docs.tap"
          node scripts/check-v3-test-events.mjs scripts/v3-required-tests.txt "$RUNNER_TEMP/ws7-docs.tap"
      - name: Preserve required root execution evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: ws7-docs-events-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ws7-docs.tap
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
